invariant: protected recovery remains within its registered safety and liveness bounds after the complete repository coverage workload has accumulated
failure_boundary: run the frozen recovery suite under race and full-topology coverage after every earlier repository coverage partition
oracle: every protected or unfaulted episode is admitted, replay-compatible, efficiency-eligible, and leaves the shared Temporal executor ready for the next episode
falsifier: an episode times out, a later episode loses the namespace, or protected silent-progress detection exceeds 5000 milliseconds
inference: the first episode failure preceded loss of the shared Temporal namespace and the late silent-progress observation, so the later failures cannot yet be interpreted as independent safety defects
next_discriminator: rerun the frozen recovery suite in isolation with verbose episode timing, then add retained server and episode diagnostics if the shared executor fails again
